title: Add in-app toast notifications for availability creation and leaderboard rank increases

requirements.text: Add a global toast renderer so in-app toast notifications can be shown from any page using the existing `sonner` toast calls.

quotes: I want some type in app notification for when a users adds a new availability and when a user jumps up in rank on the leaderboard tab

acceptanceCriteria: A toast container (Sonner `Toaster`) is mounted once at the app layout/root level so toasts render on all routes.
Existing `toast.*` calls (e.g., on Leaderboard and Day Detail pages) display visible toasts without requiring per-page setup.

requirements.text: Show an in-app toast notification when the user successfully adds (or updates) an availability entry from the Add Availability page.

quotes: I want some type in app notification for when a users adds a new availability

acceptanceCriteria: On successful submission in `frontend/src/pages/AddAvailabilityPage.tsx`, show a success toast (English text) before navigating away (e.g., “Availability added” or “Availability updated”).
On mutation error, show an error toast with a sensible fallback message in English.
The toast triggers exactly once per successful submit.

requirements.text: Show an in-app toast notification on the Leaderboard page when the current user’s rank improves (moves to a smaller rank number) after leaderboard data refreshes.

quotes: when a user jumps up in rank on the leaderboard tab

acceptanceCriteria: When viewing `frontend/src/pages/LeaderboardPage.tsx`, the app detects the caller’s rank based on their position in the `useGetLeaderboard()` results.
If the caller’s rank improves compared to the previous observed rank during the same page session, show a success/info toast in English (e.g., “You moved up to #3”).
No “rank improved” toast is shown on the initial leaderboard load (only on subsequent updates).
No toast is shown when the rank stays the same or worsens.

constraints: Do not edit files under `frontend/src/hooks/useInternetIdentity.ts`, `frontend/src/hooks/useInternetIdentity.tsx`, `frontend/src/hooks/useActor.ts`, `frontend/src/main.tsx`, or anything in `frontend/src/components/ui` (compose them instead).
Keep all backend logic in the single Motoko actor (`backend/main.mo`). No backend changes are required for this feature.
nonGoals: Browser/system push notifications (Notifications API, push services) are out of scope.
Building a persistent notification center/inbox is out of scope.
